arguments.code:
# Filter spotify recommendations to R&B songs released in current year
from datetime import datetime

year = year  # from prior

filtered=[]
checked=[]
for rec in all_recs:
    sid=rec['song_id']
    s=apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    checked.append((sid, s.get('genre'), s.get('release_date')))
    # determine release year
    rd=s.get('release_date')
    if not rd:
        continue
    rd_dt=datetime.fromisoformat(rd.replace('Z','+00:00')) if 'T' in rd else None
    if rd_dt is None:
        # fallback parse
        try:
            rd_dt=datetime.strptime(rd[:10], '%Y-%m-%d')
        except Exception:
            rd_dt=None
    if rd_dt is None:
        continue
    if s.get('genre')=='R&B' and rd_dt.year==year:
        filtered.append({'song_id':sid,'title':s.get('title'),'release_date':rd,'genre':s.get('genre'),'artists':[a.get('name') for a in s.get('artists',[])]})

print('year', year)
print('total_recommended', len(all_recs))
print('filtered_count', len(filtered))
print('filtered', filtered)
